title: Airfare of the Week: Fiji Airways Business Class Tokyo – Sydney from $1,547 Oneway
body:
Australian Frequent Flyer
Australian Frequent Flyer - Tips, Tricks and Chat for Australian Frequent Flyers
Sydney Harbour. Photo: Adobe Stock.
Our newest Airfare of the Week belongs to Fiji Airways, which has one-way Business Class fares from Tokyo-Narita (NRT) to Sydney (SYD) via Nadi (NAN) from JPY167,260 (~AU$1,547).
Fiji Airways is a member of the Oneworld alliance, so you can earn points and status credits across a wide range of frequent flyer programs, including Qantas Frequent Flyer.
Here are the full details of this great Business Class airfare from Tokyo to Sydney.
Sample itinerary & pricing
Example pricing. Screenshot from Google Flights.
You can book this fare on the Fiji Airways website .
Note that fares and availability are subject to change. This fare may not be available by the time you read this article, and you might need to be flexible with travel dates. We recommend booking ASAP to avoid disappointment!
Travel dates & fare rules
Here are the details of this airfare:
Book by: 21 November 2026
Minimum/maximum stay: None
Stopovers: Free stopovers are permitted, so you can spend a few days in Fiji on your way home at no extra cost
Changes: You can change your flights up to 24 hours before departure for a fee of JPY15,000 (~AU$139). New travel dates must be before 18 November 2027
Cancellations: You can cancel before departure for a refund, minus a cancellation fee of 50% of the fare. That works out to JPY77,400 (~AU$716) on our sample fare. Refunds are not permitted after departure
On-board product
Fiji Airways generally flies the Airbus A330 between Tokyo and Nadi. Business Class on this aircraft features angled-flat seats in a 2-2-2 layout. They are not the most modern seats in the sky, but the layout works well for couples travelling together.
Fiji Airways A330 Business Class seats. Photo: Brandon Loo/Point Hacks.
The second flight from Nadi to Sydney is generally operated by an Airbus A350-900. This is a superior product where you will find 33 fully-flat seats in a 1-2-1 reverse-herringbone configuration.
Fiji Airways Airbus A350 Business Class. Photo: Fiji Airways.
Earning points & status credits with this airfare
This fare books into “I” class. As Fiji Airways is a member of the Oneworld alliance, you could earn points and status credits for this airfare in many Oneworld programs, including:
Qantas Frequent Flyer
Alaska Airlines Atmos Rewards
British Airways Club
For example, if you credited these flights to Qantas Frequent Flyer, you could earn at least 7,500 Qantas Points and 160 status credits. If you credited them to other Oneworld programs you could earn around 8,000 redeemable miles.
